Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

Only after UX predecessor approval: extend test/e2e/specs/channels.spec.js and existing fixtures; avoid a parallel suite. Scenarios: configure/save/reopen both SMTP limits; invalid values; existing failure switch; attachment delivery/partial failure and confirmation in existing journeys; ordinary text preserved. Reuse existing approved real-provider/stub flows rather than invent another server harness.
Tests to define now, author after approval: user-visible connector choice, size/count inputs and delivery outcome; retain existing external receipt/history assertions. Read docs/e2e-testing.md; record exact approval and fixture/environment needs.
Mocking: existing external provider boundaries, real app/NodeRouter/Engine flow.
Files/docs: existing channels browser spec, support fixtures only as necessary, scenario/validation evidence in BW. No unsupported live account provisioning.
Action reuse: validation-only, existing app operations.
